messages:
sara: heads-up — CI started failing on the audit-event validation suite after the RBAC keystore change this morning. failing tests are mostly golden fixture diffs :frowning_face:

mike: can you paste the failing snippet? is it the actor wrapping change?

sara: copying logs: ```diff
-actor: { id: "user:123", roles: ["admin"] }
+actor: { id: "user:123" }
```

julia: who landed the rbac change? i saw a PR by @charles earlier for keystore role normalization.

charles: that was me — I removed role enrichment for some system events to avoid leaking roles to external customers. i must've missed audit event canonicalization.

mike: looks like the validator expects roles field in golden fixtures so diffs are showing up. test harness flags missing role as a schema violation.

sara: audit-bot: run report for failing tests -> https://ci.company.internal/builds/4689 (summary in thread)

audit-bot: CI Report: 14 failures in audit-event-validator, 9 are golden-fixture mismatches, 5 schema parser errors. linked files: /goldens/audit_events/*, validator v2.1.0

julia: short-term: we can either update golden fixtures to match the new behavior or make validator accept missing roles for these event types. which is correct per spec?

charles: per security spec, roles should never be emitted for external-facing events. internal-only events can keep roles. we need to update the canonical event schema to make roles optional for customer-visible events.

mike: that means schema change + golden fixture rotation. need to avoid silently breaking historical audit exports for customers. any customers relying on roles field?

sara: flagged in support: one enterprise tenant ingested audit exports into SIEM with mapping expecting roles. support ticket #3245 open.

julia: propose: 1) add optional "roles" field to schema with a deprecation note on the old contract page, 2) create migration script to regenerate golden fixtures without roles for affected event types, 3) run a compatibility check against last 90 days of audit samples, 4) ship validator change behind feature flag for 72 hours then flip.

charles: agree. for migration: i'll prepare a script that walks the goldens and strips roles where event.visibility == "customer". put it under tools/golden-rotate.

mike: CI changes: we should whitelist the validator version bump in one commit and the rotated goldens in a follow-up to make rollbacks easier. also add a test that decodes and validates real KMS-wrapped payloads — we saw a parser error in one case because envelope metadata moved.

sara: noted, adding action items to the triage doc. please include test vectors for KMS envelope variants (hsm vs cloud-kms).

julia: also add a lightweight smoke check in the presubmit that compares a small set of customer-visible sample exports against the new goldens to catch regressions early.

charles: quick Q — do we need to coordinate a customer-facing notice? or treat as internal schema tightening with migration window?

mike: because support flagged mapping breakage, opt to send a short heads-up to impacted customers and offer migration assistance. PD for customers with strict SIEM ingest.

audit-bot: Action items created: SEC-1482 (schema optional roles), SEC-1483 (golden rotation script), SEC-1484 (CI add KMS-var test vectors), SEC-1485 (customer notice draft).

sara: timeline? can we aim for a staged rollout by EOD Friday?

charles: I can get the rotation script + sample run today. will open PRs for schema and goldens tomorrow AM.

mike: I'll own the validator feature flag and the CI changes, will block other merges until we have the migration PR.

julia: I'll draft the customer notice and coordinate with support.

sara: thanks — keep updates here. if anyone hits a blocker, @channel. :thumbsup:
